titulo: Me reading the menu to order the usual
caption:
Me reading the menu to order the usual

Me reading the menu to order the usual.

With a long list of options, people lean toward the familiar one. Fewer choices usually feel easier, not worse.

Send it to the friend who has ordered the same dish for years.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, facing a paper menu on the right. A speech bubble says ooh, new! with wide eyes. Then hmm... with a tilt. Then ooh, that one! and it stretches tall. The menu disappears, its eyes turn happy with a small pulse and a bubble says the usual. At the end it narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me reading the menu to order the usual.
